title: Mixed7 Duo #05 (스테인드글라스+UV네온)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Stained Glass track): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — full body stained glass covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is solid thick glass fused directly to her form, not a garment, made of hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, densely packed edge to edge, never large sheets, each tiny pane curving to follow her body's true shape with real physical thickness, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane, each seam standing in a small raised ridge casting its own shadow, never flat. BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, bright light passing through each tiny pane with sharp refraction glints, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: back three-quarter turned, face over shoulder direct eye contact, bubble butt projected backward — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: leaded-glass platform boots 8 inch, the same dense small-pane mosaic continuing onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails to match.

#2 (UV Neon track): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 50s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, UV-reactive BLAZING silver-white locs cascading to her waist — full body UV neon lightning web bodypaint covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Bold formations — BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD lightning bolt formations branching across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID NEON YELLOW spark burst formations filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed. Under her own dedicated UV blacklight spot, zero white light reaching her specifically. Footwear: platform boots 8 inch, extra long stiletto nails BLAZING NEON UV reactive tips.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 2, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio.
